classification_flags: fresnel_single_cone, principal_part_metric_compatible, contains_axion, contains_skewon, reciprocal, pair_antisymmetric -- reported separately, replacing B4's single metric_induced boolean
corrected_claim: Metric-induced constitutive tensors are non-birefringent. Generic reciprocal constitutive tensors need not be. The converse requires additional assumptions and is subject to conformal/dilaton freedom and constitutive pieces that do not affect the Fresnel polynomial.
differentiation_exclusions: no claim is made to differentiate through branch sorting, mode switching, poles, zeros of transmission, or degeneracies. The phase sensitivity refuses to report a value when |t| falls below 1e-8, and root multiplicity carries an explicit conditioning warning because a root of multiplicity m is attainable only to about eps^(1/m).
fresnel_does_not_determine_Z: W^{bd} = Z^{abcd}k_a k_c annihilates the axion piece identically, and the cone is conformally invariant, so the Fresnel polynomial does NOT uniquely reconstruct Z^{abcd}.
root_finder: Durand-Kerner with Newton polish, clustering for multiplicity, per-root residual and conditioning warning. Replaces a sign-change scan that was blind to roots of even multiplicity.
